articles.title: Israel attacks Tehran as Iran takes aim at Gulf sites
articles.summary: Israel has launched fresh attacks on Iran, escalating Middle East tensions. Iran threatens retaliation against vital regional infrastructure. This intensifying conflict is significantly worsening the global energy crisis, highlighting the severe geopolitical and economic ramifications for international stability, a critical issue for SSB aspirants.

articles.title: Everything Nate Oats said after Alabama basketball’s dominant Texas Tech win
articles.summary: Alabama basketball secured a dominant 90-65 victory over Texas Tech in the NCAA tournament's Round of 32. This win propels the Crimson Tide into the prestigious Sweet 16 stage of the competition, where they are slated to face Michigan. The team's strong performance marks a significant advancement in the national collegiate basketball championship.

articles.title: Iran and U.S.-Israel continue to raise the stakes as Strait of Hormuz tensions build
articles.summary: Amidst the fourth week of war in the Middle East, Iran escalated its threats by warning it would target buyers of U.S. Treasury bonds. This move represents the latest development in an intensifying exchange of threats, reflecting heightened geopolitical tensions during the Trump administration's tenure, impacting global economic stability and international relations.

articles.title: Indian Army swiftly neutralises UXOs following standoff attack in Assam
articles.summary: ULFA(I) militants launched a standoff attack near an Assam Police Commando camp in Jagun, Tinsukia district, Assam, in the early hours of Sunday. The incident, reported around 0200 hours, highlights persistent internal security challenges in the region. This underscores the importance of robust counter-insurgency operations and maintaining vigilance against such threats to national stability.
